correctness.rationale: On dense y=1 chart of f=x((xz)^2+s(xz)y²+p y⁴), the polar map has coordinates [A(t):2uB(t):u²C(t)], t=xz, with Jacobian 4u² Φ(t)/A(t)^3. The full Hessian determinant equals -16 x³ times homogeneous Φ(xz/y²), hence x=0 (contracted point-image) and the three critical conics exhaust divisorial sources. The explicit nonvanishing discriminant and auxiliary resultants ensure three distinct nonzero critical parameters with all A,B,C nonzero. Each maps birationally to V²-c_i U W=0; eliminating t yields precisely the claimed binary-cubic F(V²,UW), whose nonzero discriminant and end coefficients give three distinct smooth bitangent-pencil conics. The generic fibre is cubic in t and u is uniquely recovered, so degree3. Inspected symbolic verifier’s exact polynomial identities; independently checked Hessian and critical-image resultant at s=p=1 using SymPy. This specialization corroborates the algebraic identities valid on the stated entire nonempty Zariski-open set.
